title: haronga axillaris
intro: Haronga axillaris, commonly known as the 'Garden Bitter Apple', is a plant species that belongs to the family Rutaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Haronga axillaris include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Haronga axillaris include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
